explanation: He worried the comic suite would harm his serious reputation, so the rest appeared only after his death. The Swan, a cello solo, inspired Anna Pavlova's famous dance The Dying Swan.

claims.text: The Swan was the only movement of The Carnival of the Animals that Saint-Saëns allowed to be published in his lifetime.
The Elephant, Aquarium and Fossils were published after Saint-Saëns's death.
Saint-Saëns feared The Carnival of the Animals would harm his reputation as a serious composer.
The Swan is a melody for solo cello, accompanied by pianos.
The Dying Swan, a solo dance created for Anna Pavlova, is set to The Swan.
